page.overview:
What is 40 Eridani A I?

40 Eridani A I was the first planet orbiting the star 40 Eridani A in the Vulcan system. This planet was located in the Vulcan sector, Beta Quadrant, and was approximately 16 light years from Sol.

This uninhabited class B planet had no moons.

When the Venari Ral laid Omega-47 mines around the core of Federation space in 3196, this planet was within the enclosed region. ()

In 2259, the planet's name, its position in the system, and its orbital path were seen on a display graphic of the shuttle Cervantes. ()
